fullDescription: A premium, editorial-style design system tailored for high-stakes professional services like healthcare, legal, or finance. It features a sophisticated monochromatic palette with deep teal accents (#1B7F7E), elegant typography pairing Inter (Sans) with Libre Baskerville (Serif), and a magazine-inspired asymmetric layout. Key attributes include high-contrast elements, generous whitespace, grayscale-to-color image transitions, and refined scroll-triggered animations like 'fade-up'. The design optimizes for authority and trust through a blend of bold typography, rigorous grid structures, and professional storytelling modules.

structured.summary: High-end editorial growth agency design featuring an asymmetric grid, sophisticated monochromatic palette with teal accents, and an elegant serif-sans typographic hierarchy. Focuses on authority, clarity, and trust-based storytelling.

style.description: The style is 'Professional Editorial'—combining the austerity of a luxury magazine with the functional clarity of a modern SaaS. It uses a base of 'Paper' (#FFFFFF) and 'Bone' (#F6F4F0) for backgrounds, 'Ink' (#050505) for text, and 'Teal' (#1B7F7E) as a strategic accent. Typography pairs heavy, tightly-tracked sans-serif headings (Inter) with graceful serif body text (Libre Baskerville). Visuals are characterized by grayscale imagery that reveals color on hover and subtle 0.9s ease-out animations.
style.prompt: Create a design with a 'Refined Editorial' aesthetic using a palette of Ink (#050505), Bone (#F6F4F0), Graphite (#5B5B56), and Teal (#1B7F7E). Typography: Headings in Inter (Sans), font-weight: 600-800, with letter-spacing of -0.065em; Body text in Libre Baskerville (Serif), size 20px-24px, line-height 1.6. Interactions: Implement a 'fade-up' animation (0.9s ease-out, translateY 22px) for page elements. All images should be grayscale by default, transitioning to full color with a 700ms ease duration on hover. Use rounded-full pill shapes for buttons with a hover transition that includes a slight Y-axis lift and a soft shadow (0_12px_30px_rgba(27,127,126,0.28)).

layout_and_structure.description: An asymmetric 12-column grid layout that breaks standard patterns to create a bespoke, high-end feel. It utilizes varying section backgrounds (Paper/Bone/Ink) to define distinct content phases.

prompts.prompt: Sticky navigation, 80px height, background #FFFFFF with a 10% black bottom border. Left: Brand logo with a circular #050505 icon containing a #1B7F7E dot (rotates 45deg on hover). Center: Nav links in #5B5B56 text-sm medium. Right: Call to action pill-button in #050505 with white text.

12-column grid. Left (col-1 to col-7): 'Healthcare growth studio' tag with a 56px horizontal line prefix. Giant heading (size 7.8rem, weight 600, tracking -0.065em). Sub-description split into a serif intro (col-1 to col-7) and a sans-serif detail (col-8 to col-12). Right (col-8 to col-12): Image container (82% width, aligned right) with a floating stat card overlay (top-left) and a featured story box in #050505 (bottom-left).
Horizontal banner with #F6F4F0 background and 10% black borders. Left: 2-line text-sm description. Right: 4-column grid for client names in #050505 bold sans-serif. Minimalist and airy.

Asymmetric bento grid. Feature card (7-cols): Horizontal layout, 50/50 image and text split, #F6F4F0 background, includes stats in a 2-column footer layout. Side column (5-cols): Two stacked cards—one in #050505 with white text and an 'arrow-up-right' icon, one in #FFFFFF with a teal border hover effect.

High-contrast #050505 background with white text. Left side (5-cols): Sticky-ready headline and serif description. Right side (6-cols): Vertical list with #1B7F7E numbering (01, 02, etc.), divided by 15% white borders. Bottom: 4-column grid of icon boxes (32px icons in teal) with 15% white borders.

Container with #FFFFFF background and 10% black border. Left: 6-cols containing a secondary headline and serif subtext. Right: 5-cols containing form inputs. Inputs: Square-edged, #F6F4F0 background, #050505 labels in uppercase tracking 0.16em. Primary button: Full-width #050505 pill with teal shadow on hover.

special_ui_components.description: A minimalist circular brand mark with a rotating animation.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 36px x 36px rounded-full circle in #050505. Centered inside is a 12px x 12px dot in #1B7F7E. On hovering the parent container, the black circle should rotate 45 degrees using a 300ms ease-in-out transition.

special_ui_components.description: Minimalist information card used to highlight key metrics over images.
special_ui_components.prompt: A square container (approx 190px) with #FFFFFF background and 10% black border. Content: Large text (5xl, weight 600, tracking -0.06em) for the number, followed by 8px margin and a small caption in #5B5B56 uppercase bold (tracking 0.18em).
